definition: while something else is happening
translation: trong lúc đó, trong khi đó
exampleSentence: I cooked dinner. Meanwhile, the kids did their homework.
exampleTranslation: Tôi nấu bữa tối. Trong lúc đó, bọn trẻ làm bài tập.

definition: after an event in the past
exampleSentence: The book was subsequently made into a film.
exampleTranslation: Cuốn sách sau đó được chuyển thể thành phim.

definition: after a long time, or after many things have happened
exampleSentence: We got lost, but eventually we found the hotel.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi bị lạc, nhưng cuối cùng cũng tìm thấy khách sạn.

definition: used to introduce the last in a series of things
exampleSentence: Finally, I would like to thank my family.
exampleTranslation: Sau cùng, tôi xin cảm ơn gia đình tôi.

definition: used when you say the last thing at the end of a list or series of statements
exampleSentence: Lastly, remember to lock the door when you leave.
exampleTranslation: Cuối cùng là nhớ khóa cửa khi bạn ra ngoài.

definition: used when you mention the last person or thing in a list, to emphasize that they are still important
translation: cuối cùng nhưng không kém phần quan trọng
exampleSentence: Last but not least, I want to thank our teacher.
exampleTranslation: Cuối cùng nhưng không kém phần quan trọng, tôi muốn cảm ơn thầy giáo của chúng tôi.

definition: before now or before a particular time
exampleSentence: Previously, she worked as a nurse.
exampleTranslation: Trước đây, cô ấy làm y tá.

definition: generally, after considering everything
exampleSentence: Overall, the trip was a great success.
exampleTranslation: Nhìn chung, chuyến đi rất thành công.

definition: used when you give the most basic or important fact about a situation
translation: xét cho cùng, rốt cuộc thì
exampleSentence: In the final analysis, it is your decision.
exampleTranslation: Xét cho cùng, đó là quyết định của bạn.

definition: used when you give an opinion after considering all the facts
translation: xét mọi mặt, cân nhắc kỹ thì
exampleSentence: On balance, I think we should accept the offer.
exampleTranslation: Cân nhắc kỹ thì tôi nghĩ chúng ta nên nhận lời đề nghị.

definition: used when you give a judgement after thinking about all parts of a situation
translation: xét mọi mặt, cân nhắc tất cả
exampleSentence: All things considered, it was a good year.
exampleTranslation: Xét mọi mặt, đó là một năm tốt.

definition: used before you give a very simple answer or explanation
exampleSentence: "How was the party?" "In a word, boring."
exampleTranslation: "Buổi tiệc thế nào?" "Nói gọn một từ: chán."

definition: in as few words as possible
exampleSentence: Briefly, the company needs more money.
exampleTranslation: Nói ngắn gọn, công ty cần thêm tiền.

definition: used before a statement that gives the main information in a few simple words; formal
exampleSentence: In sum, the project was a success.
exampleTranslation: Tóm lại, dự án đã thành công.

definition: used to introduce one reason for what you have just said
exampleSentence: I'm not going. For one thing, I'm too tired.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không đi đâu. Trước hết là tôi quá mệt.

definition: used when you give an example of something
translation: chẳng hạn như, ví dụ như
exampleSentence: I like fruit, such as mangoes and grapes.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích trái cây, chẳng hạn như xoài và nho.

definition: used to emphasize that something is more true or important for one thing than for others
exampleSentence: I love summer, especially the long evenings.
exampleTranslation: Tôi yêu mùa hè, nhất là những buổi tối dài.

definition: more than usual or more than others
exampleSentence: The roads are dangerous, particularly in winter.
exampleTranslation: Đường rất nguy hiểm, đặc biệt là vào mùa đông.

definition: especially; used to name the most important thing in a group
exampleSentence: I like Italian food, pasta in particular.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích đồ ăn Ý, đặc biệt là mì ống.

definition: used to say that a person or thing is a typical or the most important example of something
translation: đáng chú ý là, nổi bật là
exampleSentence: Many cities, notably Hanoi, are very crowded.
exampleTranslation: Nhiều thành phố, đáng chú ý là Hà Nội, rất đông đúc.

definition: adds new information, gives your opinion or corrects what someone said; mainly spoken
exampleSentence: Actually, I don't like coffee. I prefer tea.
exampleTranslation: Thật ra tôi không thích cà phê. Tôi thích trà hơn.

definition: introduces an extra statement that emphasizes or supports what you have just said; formal
exampleSentence: The test was difficult. Indeed, only two students passed.
exampleTranslation: Bài kiểm tra khó. Quả thật, chỉ có hai học sinh đỗ.

definition: shows that a fact can easily be noticed or understood
exampleSentence: Obviously, we can't finish this today.
exampleTranslation: Rõ ràng là hôm nay chúng ta không thể xong việc này.

definition: shows that you think something must be true, especially when people seem to disagree with you
exampleSentence: Surely you remember my name?
exampleTranslation: Chắc chắn là bạn còn nhớ tên tôi chứ?

definition: says that you have heard something is true, although you are not completely sure
exampleSentence: Apparently, the shop closed last month.
exampleTranslation: Nghe nói cửa hàng đó đã đóng cửa từ tháng trước.

definition: says that something is true because you can see that it is true
translation: rõ ràng là, hiển nhiên là
exampleSentence: Evidently, she had not read the instructions.
exampleTranslation: Rõ ràng là cô ấy chưa đọc hướng dẫn.

definition: shows that you are saying what you really think
translation: nói thẳng ra, thành thật mà nói
exampleSentence: Frankly, I don't think it will work.
exampleTranslation: Nói thẳng ra, tôi không nghĩ việc đó sẽ hiệu quả.

definition: shows that what you say next is not a joke; spoken
translation: nghiêm túc đấy, nói thật đấy
exampleSentence: Seriously, you should see a doctor.
exampleTranslation: Nói thật đấy, bạn nên đi khám bác sĩ.

definition: emphasizes that you are only giving your own opinion; spoken
translation: cá nhân tôi thì, riêng tôi thì
exampleSentence: Personally, I'd choose the blue one.
exampleTranslation: Cá nhân tôi thì chọn cái màu xanh.

definition: introduces a fact that you wish were not true
exampleSentence: Unfortunately, the tickets are sold out.
exampleTranslation: Tiếc là vé đã bán hết.

definition: says it is good that something happened, because the situation would have been worse otherwise
exampleSentence: Luckily, nobody was hurt in the accident.
exampleTranslation: May mắn là không ai bị thương trong vụ tai nạn.

definition: introduces a fact that makes you feel sad; means the same as "unfortunately"
exampleSentence: Sadly, the old theatre has closed.
exampleTranslation: Đáng buồn là nhà hát cũ đã đóng cửa.

definition: says what you hope will happen; some people think this use is incorrect
exampleSentence: Hopefully, the rain will stop by noon.
exampleTranslation: Hy vọng là trời sẽ tạnh mưa trước trưa.

definition: gives the most important reason or fact, or a simple explanation; spoken
translation: nói đơn giản thì, về cơ bản
exampleSentence: Basically, we need more time.
exampleTranslation: Nói đơn giản thì chúng ta cần thêm thời gian.

definition: introduces the most basic facts about something
translation: về bản chất, về cơ bản
exampleSentence: Essentially, the two plans are the same.
exampleTranslation: Về bản chất, hai kế hoạch này giống nhau.

definition: says that something is normal and not surprising
exampleSentence: Naturally, she was upset when she lost.
exampleTranslation: Đương nhiên cô ấy buồn khi thua cuộc.

definition: says that something is definitely true
translation: chắc chắn là, không nghi ngờ gì
exampleSentence: This is undoubtedly her best film.
exampleTranslation: Đây chắc chắn là bộ phim hay nhất của cô ấy.

definition: introduces a situation in which the opposite of what you expected happens
exampleSentence: Ironically, the fire station burned down.
exampleTranslation: Trớ trêu thay, trạm cứu hỏa lại bị cháy.

definition: introduces a fact that is unexpected
exampleSentence: Surprisingly, the exam was easy.
exampleTranslation: Đáng ngạc nhiên là bài thi lại dễ.

definition: introduces a fact that you think is interesting
exampleSentence: Interestingly, most of the visitors were local people.
exampleTranslation: Điều thú vị là phần lớn du khách là người địa phương.

definition: shows that the next statement is as important as, or more important than, what you said before
exampleSentence: Importantly, the medicine has no side effects.
exampleTranslation: Điều quan trọng là thuốc này không có tác dụng phụ.

definition: says that something may be true, but you are not sure
exampleSentence: Perhaps we should leave now.
exampleTranslation: Có lẽ chúng ta nên đi ngay bây giờ.

definition: says that something may happen or be true, but you are not certain
exampleSentence: Maybe he forgot about the meeting.
exampleTranslation: Có lẽ anh ấy quên cuộc họp rồi.

definition: says what many people believe is true, especially when you disagree with them
translation: được cho là, theo lời đồn
exampleSentence: The medicine is supposedly safe, but I'm not sure.
exampleTranslation: Thuốc này được cho là an toàn, nhưng tôi không chắc.

definition: reports what people say is true, although it has not been proved; formal
translation: bị cho là, theo cáo buộc
exampleSentence: He allegedly took the money from the company.
exampleTranslation: Ông ta bị cho là đã lấy tiền của công ty.

definition: used when you say something in words that do not have their usual meaning
translation: có thể nói như vậy, nói theo kiểu
exampleSentence: He is, so to speak, the heart of the team.
exampleTranslation: Có thể nói anh ấy là trái tim của cả đội.

definition: used when you describe something in a way that is not quite exact
translation: có thể nói là, như thể
exampleSentence: She was, as it were, a stranger in her own home.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy như thể là người lạ trong chính nhà mình.

definition: introduces the most basic and important part of an idea, belief or argument
translation: về bản chất, về cốt lõi
exampleSentence: In essence, the plan is very simple.
exampleTranslation: Về cốt lõi, kế hoạch này rất đơn giản.

definition: describes what you see as the real facts of a situation
translation: thực chất là, trên thực tế
exampleSentence: In effect, the manager made the decision alone.
exampleTranslation: Thực chất là người quản lý đã tự quyết định một mình.

definition: says that something is different from what people think
exampleSentence: He looks calm, but in reality he is very nervous.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy trông bình tĩnh, nhưng thực ra rất lo lắng.
